attempts.summary: node1 now serves HTTPS on port 8443 using a locally generated self-signed certificate. A persistent systemd timer checks twice daily and renews certificates within 30 days of expiry. nginx gracefully reloads new certificates without interrupting requests. Configuration and certificate survived a verified node reboot; AlmaLinux 9.6 and kernel 5.14.0-570.12.1.el9_6 remain unchanged.
